description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions for translating and processing HTML content within Markdown documents. It uses the goldmark library for Markdown parsing and the html package for HTML tokenization, integrating translation capabilities into HTML blocks.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Main function that parses a Markdown string, finds HTML blocks, and replaces their content with translated versions.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the start and stop positions of an HTML block within the source byte slice.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies sorted HTML replacements to the original body string, producing the final translated content.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts the HTML replacements in order of their start position.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Processes individual HTML snippets, tokenizing and translating text nodes while respecting tags that should be skipped.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines whether a text node should be translated based on its content and current skip depth.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag should be skipped during translation, e.g., code, pre, script, style.
